old: This list should also include your thoughts on sexuality and gender, and whether or not LGBTQ+ people would be able to live openly in your community, to date or be in relationships, and stay fully protected by the community. You should also include whether or not children should be taught to question their sexual identities from a young age, and what happens if one of the community’s children comes out as gay or transgender. Until you answer these questions, you don’t have your community’s values on freedom and raising children complete. Both of them!

old: Once you know what matters to you, look past what the group says about itself to how it really works. A recent conflict is a good place to start: how did that get handled? There’s also who can block a decision, and what happened to the last person who left. (And who owns the land!) Then it comes down to whether that’s how you want to live. These are uncomfortable conversations, I know, but the view isn’t going anywhere!
